cover_headline: UK Doubles Settlement Wait to Ten Years, Keeps Five-Year Route for Care Workers
facts: The standard wait for UK settlement will double from five years to ten, applied retrospectively to workers already in Britain
Care workers keep a five-year route if they earn at least £25,000 a year and have met their visa conditions
Earning at least £50,271 a year keeps settlement at five years; more than £125,000 brings it down to three

quote.text: Those who contribute most will settle fastest. Those who don't play by the rules will be refused or wait longer.
quote.speaker: Shabana Mahmood

end.headline: UK Doubles Settlement Wait to Ten Years, Keeps Five-Year Route for Care Workers
end.line: The standard settlement wait doubles to ten years, but care workers earning at least £25,000 keep a five-year route.
